notes.title: Steam Release Today at 8am EST!
notes.content:
Good Morning Everyone,

Just to clear up any confusion that may occur:
The time of scheduled release says midnight, but the Trails of the Gauntlet will be released at 8am (Eastern Standard Time) on Friday the 16th. Thank you for all of the support and enthusiasm over the game! You all are amazing! We couldn't have asked for a better community!

As a note to anyone new to the Trials of the Gauntlet, this was our midterm project for the B.S. in Game Development at Full Sail University. Our assignment was to create the game from concept to completion in 3 months, so we had to prioritize our bug fixing to the moderate and critical only. You will likely encounter graphical bugs while playing, such as the when you die in mid air, the death animation will play, and your character will float gently toward the ground in a pool of his own blood. XD 
We hope that the community will forgive and embrace the graphical bugs like this, and please let us know via Contact@BrokenDinosaur.com if you run into any critical bugs that make you angry! (There are none to our knowledge)

Thanks again for all the good vibes as we debut our first shipped title even before graduation!

Love,
Broken Dinosaur Studios
